description:
Renders a timeline the way an export does and reports what fails. inspect_timeline shows a few frames through the preview path, which quietly substitutes a nearby picture where a frame cannot be rendered; this renders every motion segment the timeline reads (through every nested timeline) exactly, then composites every frame with every layer (footage decoded), and fails where an export would.
Returns {jobId}; poll get_job_status every ~5 s. When done, `result` is {verdict: ok | problems | incomplete, checked, notChecked, segments, chunks, problems: [...same shape as get_problems, with `related` warnings that often name the cause...], stale?, note}. `incomplete` is NOT a pass: something could not be checked. `stale: true` means the timeline was edited while it ran — verify again. Sound is not checked. Needs the project open in the editor tab you are paired with (error PROJECT_NOT_OPEN otherwise).

cancel.description: Stop the verification of this timeline that is running.

timelineId.description: Timeline to verify (nested timelines inside it are verified too).

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: verify_timeline
title: Verify timeline
